correctness.rationale: The full facet list is replayed. Three-neighborliness implies every missing four-set carries a tetrahedral 2-cycle, and there are exactly 105 such supports. The displayed integral 2-cocycle is checked on all 390 tetrahedra and evaluates plus or minus one on every missing tetrahedral boundary, which proves primitivity directly. Exact mod-two boundary ranks independently confirm H2(F2) has dimension one and every missing carrier is nonzero.

value.rationale: The complex is vertex-minimal in dimension five and has rank-one middle homology. Determining the minimum simplicial support of its generator is a natural combinatorial systolic question. The complete answer is unusually strong: every missing tetrahedron is primitive, and an explicit sparse integral cocycle certifies all 105 cases uniformly.
